'''Sleeping [[Rose (flower)/Legends|Rose]]''' was an establishment in a seedy part of the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Underworld]], situated next to [[Enmonst Rclub/Legends|Enmonst Rclub]]. Aurebesh signage spelled out the name. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] stayed in an apartment in the same block as Sleeping Rose, while planning the [[Raid on the Jedi Temple/Legends|Mission to the Jedi Temple]].

==Behind the scenes==
During pre-production, the establishment was called "[[Hotel/Legends|Hotel]] 77", as seen in concept art of the Coruscant underworld.<ref name="SW-Holocron Heist - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep201|text="Holocron Heist" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}} {{C|Slide 10}}</ref>
